import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, mkdirSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { resolve, join, extname } from 'node:path'
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { createServer } from 'node:http'
import { spawn } from 'node:child_process'
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'
import { child } from './session-lifecycle.mjs'
import { livePreviewScript, watchProject } from './live-preview.mjs'

export function projectType(root) {
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'package.json'))) {
    const p = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'), 'utf8'))
    if (p.dependencies?.next || p.devDependencies?.next) throw new Error('Unsupported framework: customize start.sh and provide static deployment output.')
    if (p.dependencies?.vite || p.devDependencies?.vite) return 'vite'
    throw new Error('Unsupported package project: customize start.sh and deployment output.')
  }
  if (existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) return 'html'
  throw new Error('No generated index.html or supported package project.')
}
export async function start(root = process.cwd()) {
  const type = projectType(root)
  const projectRoot = resolve(root)
  if (type === 'vite') {
    const stampDir = process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR || join(root, 'node_modules', '.cache')
    mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
    const stamp = join(stampDir, 'default-dependencies')
    const lock = join(root, 'package-lock.json')
    const hash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
    let old = ''
    try { old = readFileSync(stamp, 'utf8') } catch {}
    if (old !== hash || !existsSync(join(root, 'node_modules/vite'))) {
      await child('npm', [existsSync(lock) ? 'ci' : 'install', '--no-audit', '--no-fund'], { cwd: root })
      mkdirSync(stampDir, { recursive: true })
      const installedHash = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(join(root, 'package.json'))).update(existsSync(lock) ? readFileSync(lock) : '').digest('hex')
      writeFileSync(stamp, installedHash)
    }
    await child(process.execPath, [join(root, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './'], { cwd: root })
    root = join(root, 'dist')
  }
  if (!existsSync(join(root, 'index.html'))) throw new Error('Static deployment output must contain index.html.')
  if (process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR) writeFileSync(join(process.env.OPENCODE_WEB_DIR, 'deployment-output.json'), JSON.stringify({ project: projectRoot, directory: resolve(root) }))
  const mime = { '.html':'text/html', '.js':'application/javascript', '.css':'text/css', '.json':'application/json', '.svg':'image/svg+xml', '.png':'image/png', '.jpg':'image/jpeg', '.webp':'image/webp', '.wasm':'application/wasm', '.glb':'model/gltf-binary' }
  const clients = new Set()
  const stopWatching = watchProject(root, () => { for (const client of clients) client.write('event: change\ndata: changed\n\n') })
  const keepAlive = setInterval(() => { for (const client of clients) client.write(': keepalive\n\n') }, 20000)
  const buildWatcher = type === 'vite' ? spawn(process.execPath, [join(projectRoot, 'node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js'), 'build', '--base', './', '--watch'], { cwd: projectRoot, stdio: 'inherit' }) : null
  const server = createServer((req, res) => {
    try {
      const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
      if (url.pathname === '/__omgithub/live') {
        res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': 'text/event-stream', 'Cache-Control': 'no-cache', 'X-Accel-Buffering': 'no', Connection: 'keep-alive' })
        res.write(': connected\n\n')
        clients.add(res)
        req.on('close', () => clients.delete(res))
        return
      }
      const path = resolve(root, '.' + decodeURIComponent(url.pathname))
      if (path !== resolve(root) && !path.startsWith(resolve(root) + '/')) { res.writeHead(404); res.end(); return }
      const file = statSync(path).isDirectory() ? join(path, 'index.html') : path
      res.setHeader('Content-Type', mime[extname(file)] || 'application/octet-stream')
      res.setHeader('Cache-Control', url.searchParams.has('omgithub_live') ? 'no-store' : 'no-cache')
      const content = readFileSync(file)
      if (extname(file) === '.html' && url.searchParams.get('omgithub_live') === '1') {
        const html = content.toString()
        res.end(/<\/body\s*>/i.test(html) ? html.replace(/<\/body\s*>/i, `${livePreviewScript}</body>`) : html + livePreviewScript)
      } else res.end(content)
    } catch { res.writeHead(404); res.end('Not found') }
  })
  server.on('close', () => { stopWatching(); clearInterval(keepAlive); buildWatcher?.kill(); for (const client of clients) client.end() })
  server.listen(Number(process.env.PORT || 3000), '0.0.0.0')
  return server
}
if (process.argv[1] && import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href) await start()

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a polished 3D Mario Kart-style browser racer with gravity flips, playable on desktop and mobile.

## Requirements
- User brief: “3D Mario Kart-style racer with gravity flips”.
- Must support Android/iOS touch controls, responsive layout, safe areas.
- User asked “Progress?” mid-build; no additional feature requirements given.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a Vite + Three.js static web game with procedural low-poly assets (no external models).
- Chose spline-based arcade racing: karts follow a 3D ribbon track with banked/rolled “gravity flip” barrel-roll zones.
- Added 8 racers, 3 laps, drift/mini-turbo, coins, item boxes, items, boost pads, minimap, countdown, results, pause, procedural audio.
- Auto-throttle enabled so game is playable immediately; W/Up increases speed.
- Added software-renderer detection (`llvmpipe`/`SwiftShader`) with `lowPower` mode disabling bloom and using lower resolution.
- Low-power mode currently runs ~4 fps in the test environment; visual screenshots still work.

## Work State
### Completed
- Project scaffold, Vite config, package dependencies (`three@0.180.0`, `vite@7.1.5`).
- Full UI shell and styling (`index.html`, `src/style.css`).
- Procedural track with start gate, boost pads, gravity rings, checker line, rails, beacons.
- Sky/world with floating islands, clouds, stars, planet, dust, balloons.
- Kart models, AI racers, player physics, drift, boosts, items, coins, collisions.
- HUD, minimap, countdown, banners, results, pause, touch controls, audio.
- Gravity flip zones at `u≈0.29–0.43` and `u≈0.60–0.74`.
- Production build passes with `npm run build`.
- Menu composition iterated; latest version shows karts center-right, gate, track, floating islands.
- Added item-specific CSS, favicon, low-power mode, wall-clock countdown, closer chase camera, reduced edge glow.

### Active
- Visual/UX polish and validation of gameplay, gravity flips, mobile layout, and performance.
- Need to re-test latest camera/edge/item changes after rebuild.

### Blocked
- No hard blockers.
- Software renderer (`llvmpipe`) is very slow (~4 fps); full real-time verification is difficult.

## Next Move
1. Reload dev server and capture latest menu, countdown, gameplay screenshots to verify camera, glow, item boxes.
2. Test gravity-flip view by using debug teleport (`window.__gravityGame.teleport(u, lap)`) to `u≈0.36` and `u≈0.67`.
3. Verify drift/boost/item pickup and race finish/results flow.
4. Test responsive mobile layout at e.g. 390×844 and landscape.
5. Tune AI speeds/race balance; player currently can reach 1st too quickly.
6. Re-run `npm run build`, inspect console errors, update README, and stop dev server when done.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: game loop, racers, camera, HUD, input, race flow, debug API.
- `src/track.js`: spline track, roll zones, geometry, gate, pads, rings, beacons.
- `src/world.js`: sky shader, clouds (instanced), islands, planet, dust.
- `src/kart.js`: procedural kart model and visual animation.
- `src/pickups.js`: coins and item boxes.
- `src/effects.js`: particle system.
- `src/audio.js`: procedural WebAudio engine/SFX/music.
- `src/style.css`: complete UI, HUD, menu, responsive/touch styling.
- `index.html`: DOM structure and favicon.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and dependencies.
- `screenshots/`: latest visual references (`menu6.png`, `race3.png`, etc.).
- `dist/`: latest production build.

## Important Context
- Dev server is running in tmux session `gravity` at `http://localhost:3002` via `npm run dev`.
- Playwright session is open; `playwright-cli` browser is installed at `chromium-1248`, but CLI initially requested `chromium-1243`; it now works.
- Test renderer string: `ANGLE (Mesa, Vulkan ... llvmpipe ...)`; low-power mode is active.
- Start button animation makes Playwright `click` unstable; use `playwright-cli press Enter` or force click.
- Debug API: `window.__gravityGame.start()`, `.state()`, `.racers()`, `.player()`, `.teleport(u, lap)`, `.quality()`, `.renderInfo()`, `.bloom(bool)`, `.game`.
- Current render info before recent changes: ~617 draw calls, ~166k triangles.
- Track length ≈ `728.74`; player starts 6th at grid index 5.
- Latest build command: `npm run build`.
- Console had earlier fixed error: `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'scale')` in `Pickups.update`; fixed by storing `edges`.
- `Agents.md` requires persistent tmux servers and SwiftShader capture workflow, but that is environment guidance rather than user content.

# Gravity Grand Prix

A 3D anti-gravity kart racer that runs in the browser. Eight racers, four laps, two barrel-roll gravity-flip sectors, and a full arcade layer of drifting, mini-turbos, coins, items, and boost pads. Built with Vite + Three.js and procedurally generated assets — no external models or textures.

## Play

```bash
npm install
npm run dev      # http://localhost:3002
npm run build    # production build in dist/
npm run preview  # serve the production build
```

Open the page, press **Enter** (or tap **START ENGINE**), and race.

## Controls

| Action | Desktop | Touch |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Accelerate | `W` / `↑` (auto-throttle is on) | Automatic |
| Steer | `A` / `D` or `←` / `→` | Left / right pads |
| Drift + mini-turbo | `Space` while steering | **DRIFT** |
| Use item | `E` | **ITEM** |
| Pause | `P` / `Esc` | Pause button |

## Features

- Spline-based 3D ribbon track with banked turns, a start gate, boost pads, and two gravity-flip barrel-roll sectors.
- Eight racers with light rubber-banding, item rolls, spin-outs, and shield/star/turbo/pulse effects.
- Drift charge with three mini-turbo tiers, coin-based top-speed bonus, and boost pads.
- HUD with position, lap counter, race clock, speedometer, drift charge, item slot, and minimap.
- Responsive layout with safe-area padding and dedicated touch controls for phones and tablets in portrait and landscape.
- Procedural audio: engine pitch, countdown, pickups, drift release, music, and finish sting.
- Automatic low-power fallback for software WebGL renderers (`llvmpipe` / SwiftShader): disables bloom and lowers the render resolution.

## Notes

- Race length is 4 laps; results include total time, best lap, top speed, and a full eight-racer classification.
- Tested with Chromium at 390×844, 844×390, and desktop sizes.
- On a CPU software renderer the frame rate is low by nature; real GPU-backed browsers run the intended path with bloom enabled.

**Gravity Grand Prix** is built and playable at **http://localhost:3002** (dev server still running).

### What’s in it
- **8-racer arcade GP** on a spline-based 3D ribbon track with banked turns, boost pads, item boxes, coins, and two barrel-roll **gravity-flip sectors**.
- **4 laps**, live position/lap/time HUD, minimap, countdown, banners, pause, and a full results classification with best lap and top speed.
- **Drift + 3-tier mini-turbo**, item rolls (turbo, star, shield, pulse shockwave), spin-outs, and shield/star effects.
- **Procedural everything**: karts, track, floating islands, clouds, planet, particles, and WebAudio engine/SFX/music. No external assets.
- **Mobile support**: responsive portrait + landscape layouts, safe-area padding, and touch steering / drift / item buttons. Touch input handlers were verified.
- **Auto low-power fallback** for software WebGL renderers (bloom off, lower render scale).

### Controls
| Action | Desktop | Touch |
|---|---|---|
| Accelerate | `W` / `↑` (auto-throttle on) | Auto |
| Steer | `A` / `D` / arrows | ◀ ▶ |
| Drift | `Space` while steering | DRIFT |
| Item | `E` | ITEM |
| Pause | `P` / `Esc` | Pause button |

### Verified
- Menu, countdown, racing, gravity-flip zones, pause, and results flow.
- Desktop **1280×800**, portrait **390×844 / 375×667**, landscape **844×390**.
- Race balance: AI finishes within ~3s of the player over 4 laps.
- Item effects, drift input, touch buttons, and restart all work.
- `npm run build` passes; **0 console errors/warnings**.

Key screenshots: `screenshots/desktop-menu-final.png`, `desktop-race-final.png`, `desktop-results-final.png`, `mobile-race6.png`, `landscape-race3.png`.

Note: this environment uses Chromium’s **llvmpipe software renderer**, so frame rate is low here; the game automatically drops to low-power mode. Real GPU browsers use the full bloom path.
